about: zonegfx (r17): textured, lit, animated zone look, drawn by js/ab-zonegfx.js. A zone gets the look when zones[zoneId] or palettes[palette] names a set (sample: only reed_marsh). Each set = one act/biome art kit: gen (texture recipes for tools/gen_zonegfx.py -> assets/zonegfx/<set>/), bake (ground splat: materials, blend, relief, decals, cast shadows; baked once per zone load into the ground picture) and live (per-frame: water, foliage sway, lanterns, banners, motes, fog, grade, light tint). low = overrides for the low-graphics setting (Settings gfx low, or ?zgfx=low). ?zgfx=0 turns the whole thing off. Gameplay never reads this file: tiles, walls, collision and props are untouched; foliage, lanterns and banners here are decoration only (no hit boxes) and are kept off the path and away from doors.

low._doc: LOW_FX overrides (settings Graphics: Low, config LOW_FX, or ?zgfx=low): smaller ground bake, no water anim/sway/motes/fog/grade/banners/detail overlay, fewer plants, no decorative fringe trees; the game drops to DPR 2.

mere.label: The Mere (Reed Marsh sample): black-glass water, wet silt, moss banks, teal fill, fish-oil lantern accents. Key light upper-left, shadows lower-right.

tone._doc: v84m2 per-material tone at bake time: contrast = overlay of the texture on itself (0..1), lift = screen colour at liftAlpha. Makes the path a bit lighter and higher-contrast than the ground so the route reads at a glance.

path._doc: v84m2 path readability: plants, reeds and wall-fringe thickets never stand on a road tile or within margin (tiles) of one; on tiles within nearDist of a road only nearMul of the usual plants are kept (0.62 = about 38% fewer); props:true applies the same to the game's own grid plants (small ones, plus the tall kinds in propKinds, e.g. reed clumps); trees and rocks on their solid tiles are kept.

walls._outerDoc: outerFaces false: the outer ring's wall faces that point off the map (south face of the last row, east face of the last column) are not drawn and the backdrop canopy is painted over the outer ring's ground (outerRing tiles), so no dark band runs past the map edge.

import.about: painted source art (generated for this project, see assets/zonegfx/CREDITS.md) -> tools/import_zonegfx.py

tod._doc: Time of day. mode: real (device clock) | day | dusk | night | dawn (settings.tod overrides; ?tod= / ?todh= for tests). schedule = [hour, preset] keys, smooth blend between neighbours. presets = partial overrides of sets.<id>.live blocks; a set can override with sets.<id>.tod.presets. night = the base live look.

weather._doc: Weather hook (no renderers yet). ABZoneGfx.setWeather(state, amount 0-1) blends states.<s>.live overrides over the time-of-day look; ABZoneGfx.registerWeather(state, {draw(e, view)}) plugs a renderer post() calls. Later: drive from real-world weather.

liquid._doc: Old-renderer colours for the LAVA tile per palette where it is water (every zone of that palette, with or without a painted set). glow:false drops the orange lava glow circles.

stagingTest._doc: STAGING ONLY (config STAGING: true; js/ab-testtools.js is never loaded on live). Menu button that takes the current hero straight into a zone through the normal zone-travel path (arrive at the zone start, door back to the previous town, waypoint found by walking to it, game saved). clamp: while that zone is built, monster level is capped at hero level + above (range span levels wide, never above the zone's own levels); leaving and coming back later builds the zone at its real levels.
